title: Next Technology (NXTT) Sells 500 Bitcoin to Fund AI Push
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Next Technology (NXTT) Sells 500 Bitcoin to Fund AI Push Next Technology sold about 500 BTC for $29.22 million to fund AI work, cutting its holdings to 5,333 BTC, and said it does not expect to buy more bitcoin. This post Next Technology (NXTT) Sells 500 Bitcoin to Fund AI Push first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
